proposition: Even his most esoteric works name the Companions and Successors; the Mafāḥiṣ grounds the letter's supremacy in the Quran, hadith, ṣaḥāba and tābiʿūn (ʿAlī and Ḥusayn among the latter) and in Ibn Ḥanbal and Shāfiʿī on the uncreated Quran.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka in his own doctrinal work, as summarised by MK
mediation.where: MS Majlis 10196 and other manuscripts as cited by MK
